decisions.reason: Its closeness to the firm's core data-centre and fibre-network knowledge and the positive early adoption indicate high absorptive capacity and very low exit probability.
Building on the firm's established optical and wavelength expertise with dedicated product-page support enables strong learning and improvement, so withdrawal is unlikely.
The portal leverages existing voice and software-platform knowledge, allowing the firm to assimilate user feedback and improve it, so a drop is improbable.
Although it is close to the firm's voice capabilities, carrier pre-selection is a declining legacy service with limited commercial application, and the firm can read weak signals and exit.
Direct voice network connection builds on established network and voice assets and remains relevant for enterprise customers, so the firm can learn and improve rather than drop.
